# app/models/article.rb
class Article < ApplicationRecord
  include Ransack::Search

  def self.search(query)
    if query.present?
      search_params = {
        title_or_body_cont: query
      }
      ransack(search_params).order(created_at: :desc)
    else
      all.order(created_at: :desc)
    end
  end
end
